title: Using a past success responsibly
known_facts: The earlier call was lower stakes
opening_case: A salesperson recalls handling one objection well before a different, harder conversation.

nodes.prompt: A salesperson recalls handling one objection well before a different, harder conversation. Choose your first response.

choices.text: Identify transferable steps and rehearse the new concern
choices.rationale: This preserves a possible evidence-gathering route.

choices.text: Use the prior success as motivation while seeking fresh facts
choices.rationale: This is another plausible route; later options may change the result.

nodes.prompt: The new objection is different. Next?

choices.text: Ask a clarifying question and adapt
choices.rationale: Consider practical limits, context and autonomy.

choices.text: Repeat the old script regardless of context
choices.rationale: Consider whether a broad interpretation exceeds the evidence.

nodes.prompt: The prospect is not persuaded. Next?

choices.text: Record what was learned without assuming failure identity
choices.rationale: Consider whether an additional observation is possible.

choices.text: Conclude the winning feeling was fraudulent
choices.rationale: Consider what remains unknown and who else is affected.
